data.name: TAKTAKTOP
data.detailed_description:
TAKTAKTOP

A sky-high jump action escape game where falling means game over! Features "Platform Builder" mode, where you shoot and create your own footholds, and "Random Platform" mode, where you compete on constantly shifting terrain. Support allies by shooting tokens at them with missiles, take advantage of the unique rule where players with zero tokens are immune to attacks, and become the ultimate survivor. (Supports up to 12-player multiplayer)

Platform Builder

Short Description: Escape by creating your own path in empty mid-air! Press the fire button to launch a projectile, then trigger it at the right moment to turn it into a platform. However, your platform capacity is limited, so placing a new foothold will despawn the oldest one.

Detailed Description: No floor, no path. Build your own way up! Your sole objective is to survive and reach the escape portal floating high in the sky.

- Platform Creation Timing: Pressing the fire button launches a projectile in an arc. Press it once more at the exact timing to spawn a solid platform on that spot.

- Shifting Ground: Spawned platforms have randomized shapes and angles. There is a limit to how many platforms you can keep active, meaning older platforms disappear in sequence as new ones are placed.

- Disrupting Rivals: Any opponent standing where a platform spawns is pushed outward. Use this mechanic for mind games to block paths or push rivals off the edge.

Mode Features:

- Pure jumping and building competition with zero combat or attacks

- Intuitive gameplay without complex skills or items

Random Platform

Short Description: Leap across countless footholds to escape before time runs out! All platforms shuffle periodically, keeping you constantly on the move. Shoot missiles to transfer your tokens to struggling players, and enjoy attack immunity when your token count hits zero. Even if you fall, spend tokens to revive instantly.

Detailed Description: The sky has lost all ground. Climb across randomly shifting platforms and ascend to the top escape portal!

- Supporting Allies with Missile Fire: Missiles are support tools used to transfer your tokens by hitting teammates. Help allies escape or revive by boosting their funds. Players with zero tokens cannot be hit as missiles pass straight through them.

Token Utility System:

- Destroy crates to earn tokens (more hits grant bonus tokens)

- Spend tokens to instantly revive on a nearby platform upon falling

- Run out of tokens and face elimination, but allies can spend tokens to revive you

- Consume tokens to rescue falling players

- Spend tokens to unlock and switch special weapons

- Escape Conditions: The escape device at the summit only admits players who hold a required amount of tokens. This is not a winner-takes-all race; everyone who meets the criteria can escape together.

Mode Features:

- Up to 12-player online multiplayer

- Win purely through smart token management and platforming precision, free of complex skill trees

data.short_description: Vertical jump action to escape the sky! Shoot projectiles to pave your way in Build Mode, or adapt to shifting tiles in Random Mode. Pass tokens via missiles to aid or revive allies—stay immune while tokenless. Reach the top exit with tokens to win! (Up to 12 players online)
data.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit (version 1909 or later)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6GB / AMD Radeon RX 580 8GB (DirectX 12 / Shader Model 6 required)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: Requires a DirectX 12 capable GPU with Shader Model 6.0. SSD recommended.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-10700 / AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 / AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 15 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains mild, cartoon-style violence. Players fire energy
missiles at one another in a non-realistic, bloodless combat system
with no gore.

Some character costumes are revealing (e.g. swimsuits/bikinis), and
the game includes stylized body physics. There is no nudity, no
sexual acts, and no explicit sexual content. The game does not
contain depictions of sexual violence, drug or alcohol abuse, or
self-harm.

This is an online multiplayer game; player interactions occur in
real time.
